title: Egyptian Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and quick Egyptian-inspired chicken wrap recipe. Serve with your favorite sides for a delicious meal.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and your favorite spices.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spread the hummus on the wrap, leaving a small border around the edges.
Add the cooked chicken, cucumber, tomato, and parsley on top of the hummus.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
